# Guides

- [Build a customer loyalty program with Entity Workflows](https://docs.temporal.io/guides/entity-pattern-loyalty-points.md)
- [Build a distributed lock and semaphore with Workflow IDs](https://docs.temporal.io/guides/lock-shared-resources.md)
- [Rate-limit downstream APIs with separate Task Queues](https://docs.temporal.io/guides/rate-limit-downstream-apis.md)
- [Pause a Workflow on failure and resume it after a fix](https://docs.temporal.io/guides/recover-without-restart.md)
- [Build a human-in-the-loop document approval Workflow](https://docs.temporal.io/guides/reliable-document-approvals.md)
- [Route GPU and high-memory Activities to dedicated Workers](https://docs.temporal.io/guides/route-specialized-workloads.md)
- [Temporarily increase Namespace capacity on Temporal Cloud](https://docs.temporal.io/guides/temporary-rate-limit-increases.md)
- [Run all of a Workflow's Activities on the same Worker](https://docs.temporal.io/guides/worker-execution-affinity.md)
